author: _Ben_Dover
body:
• My name is _Ben_Dover
  • I was banned for Excessive chat related infractions.
  • Now, this account of mine is something that i play on a lot, and i love it... I usually leave it open whilst I'm out of the room or what so ever. My little brother Lewis is 12 years old and i allow him to play on here. What i don't know, is that he is sitting there messing around using bad language in chat. Now he has managed to get me banned permanently, just as I've bought the Diamond rank... I have told him off deeply and he will not be allowed on my computer again and i can assure you of that, everything is secured with passwords. This appeal is directed towards SnowSX3, i very much apologise for my brothers behaviour, and i am gutted that i have just spent $50 on Diamond and i now can't use that. Please take this into consideration and i can assure you that this incident of profanity will not happen again. Thank you ~_Ben_Dover

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello, 

It's your account and therefore your responsibility to make sure that your brother keeps a calm and pleasant atmosphere. You will not be appealed.

You can try to appeal this ban in a couple of months.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
